result.description: Cloud data platform (warehouse, lakehouse, AI) queried and managed via SQL and REST APIs.
result.auth_detail: SQL API/REST APIs: OAuth (custom/partner security integrations), key-pair JWT, programmatic access tokens (PAT, bearer; default 15-day expiry, network policy needed by default), workload identity federation. Each account is customer-specific (per-account hostname).
result.access_detail: No app review gate: any account admin creates own OAuth security integration or PAT. But no permanent free tier: 30-day/credit-limited trial, then account suspended until upgraded to paid with credit card. Dev needs trial or paid account; end users need paid Snowflake accounts.
result.api_notes: SQL API (submit/status/cancel statements, most DDL/DML) plus Snowflake REST APIs (OpenAPI-compliant) covering ~20 resource areas: accounts, users, roles, grants, warehouses, databases, schemas, tables, stages, tasks, Cortex AI, etc. Not 100% parity with SQL. Account-specific base URL.
result.blocker: No free tier after 30-day trial; per-account hostname/instance required; PAT/OAuth setup needs account admin.
